name: voice-message
title: Voice message
description: Dictate a message: record with the mic, transcribe with Mistral Voxtral or local Whisper (a GPU model, or a small CPU model that any machine can run), review the text, and insert it as a draft. Never sends automatically. The local engine builds its own pinned Python runtime beside the module at first use (uv or python3-venv, faster-whisper and the small model from pinned revisions); audio stays on the server unless the owner picks Mistral, whose key is read only on the server.
